title: Electrostatic Filters
description: Sky Clean Air: Experience cleaner air with our Electrostatic Filters. Our advanced technology captures microscopic particles, ensuring a healthier and fresher environment.
body:
When we service any furnace, we recommend and provide Electrostatic Filters. This will save you money and having to find the correct size in the future as these are reusable. Simply hose both sides, let dry, and put back into furnace. This is a safe, naturally occurring phenomenon in which an electrostatic charge is generated by air flowing through a maze of static prone fibers. Airborne particles are attracted and held by the static charge until released by washing.

There are various benefits to electrostatic filter:

  • 94% Arrestance
  • Anti-Microbial
  • Environmentally Friendly
  • Filters Dust and Airborne Pollutants Up To 97%
  • High Dust and Particle Holding Capacity
  • Lifetime Warranty
  • No Harmful Ozone Emissions
  • Removes Pollen
  • Standard and Costume Sizes Available
  • Washable, and Reusable
